page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps to a dedicated physical core, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing.

The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial RAM capacity and dedicated CPU resources. Suitable applications include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data caching layers, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
